concern_summary: This concern involves the operational management of workspaces, including creating, deleting, navigating, and handling workspace-specific actions and states.

This concern focuses on the functionality related to switching between workspaces, including the retrieval and display of the current workspace's avatar and name, managing active workspace IDs, and handling user interactions for workspace selection.
This concern focuses on managing workspace settings, including validation, updates, and error handling related to workspace configurations.

This concern encompasses the management and handling of payment cards within the workspace, including the display and submission of payment card forms, addition of company cards, rendering of expense card lists, managing the state of expensify cards, and retrieving cardholder information relevant to the workspace context.
This concern addresses the generation of default workspace names based on user-specific criteria, ensuring that names are unique and relevant to the user.

This concern encompasses all functionalities related to managing workspace chat environments, including the creation of workspaces, handling chat reports, managing chat rooms and participants, composing and submitting messages, and checking chat types and roles within the workspace.
This concern revolves around the active management of the current workspace, ensuring seamless navigation, state management, and user interactions based on the active workspace context.
This concern handles the fallback icon used to provide a default representation when specific user avatars are not available.
This concern determines the current actor's relationship with the workspace, adjusting display elements based on actor type and associated policies.
